prompt.outputLanguage: Conduct the conversation in {conversationLanguage}: the skill tree below is written in it, and {learnerDefinite} expects it. Do not switch language on your own initiative or comment on the language of these instructions. Address {learnerDefinite} as "you"; where the role must be named, the word is “{learnerDefinite}”.
prompt.writingStyle:
An example in English of the first piece of advice above (in another conversation language, apply the same idea in that language):
- Active voice: write "we can write the number as …", not "the number can only be written as …"; write "we do this by …" or "you do this by …", not "this is done by …". Avoid "is done" and "can be done" where you can say who does it.
